verdict.rationale: Open WebUI has a first-party plugin system: Functions are modular Python plugins, and Tools, Pipes, Filters and Pipelines all exist. The openwebui.com site says "Share what you build, run what others share," which implies a community sharing hub for these plugins. However, nothing in the evidence describes a browsable registry or a one-click or one-command install flow, and skills are only documented as local SKILL.md folders. missing for 10: documented browsable plugin/skills registry, documented one-click or one-command install, independent or hands-on corroboration of the install experience
